title: Stars and chevrons of the Ganj Ali Khan complex, Kerman
subtitle: Ganj Ali Khan complex, Kerman

given.O: The centre of an eight-pointed star, on a horizontal mirror.
given.A: Its right point, on that mirror.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s P111 drawing and its corners snapped to exact values. OA is the star’s point radius and follows a mirror. The chevrons keep their direction, so the boundaries have no half-turn. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The plain boundaries and the three source fill classes are retained. The palette is illustrative. Two ten-sided forms share one piece key because their areas, side lengths and perimeters agree; their different outlines are retained. No building photograph was checked. The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data181/P111: Ganj Ali Khan complex, Kerman
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. Mahmood Maher al-Naqsh, Design and execution of drawing in Iranian tilework, Islamic period (Reza Abbasi Museum, 1983), volume 5, page 111; Ganj Ali Khan complex, Kerman, Iran. Wichmann says the colours follow the original mosaic presentation.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They cross at K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at K1. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: The line from O to K1 crosses the circle at F. Draw a vertical line through F. It crosses the horizontal line through O at M. Turn the vertical line round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a straight line through A and C. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a circle with centre O through K1. It crosses the vertical line through O at V, above O.
Draw a horizontal line through V. Turn it round O by 180°. They cross the vertical lines through A and B at N1, N2, N3 and N4.
Draw a circle with centre B and opening from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at P, right of O. Draw a vertical line through P.

Draw a circle with centre P and opening from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at Q, right of P. Draw a line through each of P and Q at 90° to the line from O to K1. Reflect both lines in the horizontal line through O.
Join N1, N2, N3 and N4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange.

pattern.text: Put copies of the rectangular tile side by side.
